# Changelog 0.0.1493

## Changes since v0.0.1254

- Roadmap #2614 closing check: one Portable2D path for Tiled layer calls, resource factories by their package, quoted methods by their declared name, unused binding queries retired (#3018) (#3019) (`5c19809d`)
- Portable2D: the camera always exists, over the active scene, so Camera.X/Y and camera moves need no Camera.Init (#1717) (#3017) (`5f6d4f24`)
- SDK frontend: the author's physical project reaches the compilation as its files' trees; AuthoredFunctionMap and the composer's text edits go (#2889) (#3016) (`e0734db4`)
- Plugin contract: source stages retire; plugins read the program only as the analyzers' view (#2630) (#3011) (`5d3a6474`)
- Contract 0.5: extension points are named only by their library's source, checked on the bind's references; the reserved-name token guard retires (#2971) (#3010) (`acf125cd`)
- Portable2D: Game.Run is SDK code with a single-call analyzer, and ManagedGame retires (#2617) (#3008) (`93399426`)
- Portable2D: Scene.TouchTiles is SDK code that answers a walk the game dispatches on, and the TileKinds source stage retires (#2627) (#3005) (`05eada37`)
- Tests: a let local passed to pool calls builds the explicitly typed ROM (#1473) (#3004) (`25219453`)
- Tests: actor tests judge Tiled spawns by the game's pool, not by the spawn generator's state names (#2718) (#3003) (`d99c1992`)
- Portable2D: Tiled spawns are pool methods that the game analyzer generates, with their state in static fields per pool type (#2628) (#3002) (`ab47a819`)
- Portable2D: the build warns where a camera follow policy becomes dynamic, naming the setter and the static form (#2249) (#3001) (`a78b6cc5`)
- Language: a free receiver function of a physical namespace is a member of its type under its author's name (#2990) (#2999) (`d54efa10`)
- Tests: a local hiding a constant in a camera policy argument keeps the dynamic follow policy (#2247) (#2998) (`a9a540eb`)
- Portable2D: the Camera API is declared in the SDK with its state in static fields, and the camera follow is a generator of literals (#2629) (#2997) (`a2f20373`)
- Language: a value helper with statements may compute a struct or class value (#2989) (#2996) (`2cf7be6e`)
- Language: a value helper with statements need not be inline, and its value may stand in a while or for condition (#1872) (#2988) (`bd320966`)
- Plugins: Portable2D Triggers is a generator whose state lives in SDK static fields (#2626) (#2985) (`4b3f33df`)
- Language: a compile-time string selects the code an inline function and a generated document compile (#2978) (#2983) (`111c77c3`)
- Diagnostics: a game with its own loop that calls Scene.Activate is refused at the call, pinned by a test (#2534) (#2977) (`5ba5d0e8`)
- Plugins: a generated document names a declaration of a game's physical namespaces by the program's name (#2972) (#2976) (`33f10364`)
- Contract 0.5: Portable2D's managed-game checks read the program view; the bound-program policies and sdk_source_anchor retire (#2716) (#2975) (`bda81c0e`)
- Plugins: a generated document specializes an extension point for a game type; unconstrained generics and global:: (#2966) (#2974) (`db960602`)
- Contract 0.5: the view reads the target's constants and says which flow folding keeps (#2959) (#2969) (`c891086a`)
- Plugins: the generator context reads resources, declares ROM tables and lets a generated document declare its own symbols (#2958) (#2965) (`e0968d64`)
- Plugins: SDK extension points and generated documents; Game.Run's services are extension points a policy implements late (#2624) (#2963) (`595d7b1c`)
- Language: a repeated function, receiver method or member in a physical namespace is named as written (#2414) (#2960) (`0ffe4156`)
- Bind: a bare name sees its namespace and those around it, then its usings and the roots, not a namespace inside or beside it (#2422) (#2954) (`a432c0eb`)
- Language: constraint, conformance and contract errors name declarations as their author wrote them (#2658) (#2952) (`18bd817e`)
- Tests: a physical library's const array is read by countof and by an indexed receiver call (#2651) (#2951) (`b27e8403`)
- Bind: a generic call's type arguments, written or inferred, are the bind's data; the plugin view reads them (#2939) (#2948) (`5a19cbba`)
- Portable2D: SpriteEffects becomes a program analyzer over the semantic view and reports at the effect argument (#2625) (#2946) (`39466fa0`)
- SDK plugins: a policy reads the program as written, as the bind resolves it, and reports at its elements (#2623) (#2943) (`c6bc29e9`)
- Portable2D: Camera.Follow exists only under Game.Run; retire its own-loop form (#2829) (#2941) (`ac92cf0e`)
- Language: a value helper's result is its return type's value on every target (#2886) (#2937) (`fe52ac93`)
- SDK frontend: the operation collectors select runtime routines from the program after constant-branch removal (#2880) (#2936) (`47b78709`)
- Language: an argument with effects to a call that a copied statement body passes its case view to runs once (#2920) (#2932) (`77df421e`)
- Language: an enum member computes as a variable of its enum, in the integer type that stores it (#2838) (#2931) (`0258e4d3`)
- Language: a typed constant computes at its type's width, as a variable of that type does (#2885) (#2928) (`be0e01b9`)
- Language: a library's call that no scope declares is an error at the call, as the author's is (#2881) (#2925) (`a5d659af`)
- Language: an argument with effects to a call the union lowering expands by name runs once (#2753) (#2922) (`8a35241f`)
- SDK frontend: the selector lowering quotes values through the source text writer, not a receiver rule of its own (#2835) (#2919) (`7203ac49`)
- Rules: mutation checks run with tools/test/mutate.py, and the reviewer may run it to confirm a mutant (#2916) (#2917) (`31e03fc2`)
- Tools: mutate.py runs a session's mutation checks from a list, and suite.py writes its outcome as data (#2760) (#2915) (`487c4ffa`)
- Rules: the worktree's command rule moves into AGENTS.md and states the isolation's criterion (#2901) (#2914) (`b8f8b22f`)
- Rules: a finding that belongs to another open issue goes to it with issue.py note (#2911) (#2913) (`8ad342d9`)
- Tools: issue.py note leaves a finding on the open issue it belongs to, and block --note-file leaves it on the blocker (#2842) (#2912) (`e71e7087`)
- Tools: suite.py lets a slow project close to its end finish after another fails (#2888) (#2910) (`521562ea`)
- Rules: the reviewer and the /issue author probe with probe.py, and the author runs --base before each handback (#2897) (#2908) (`8c749537`)
- Rules: the agents of a claimed issue work under the directory issue.py claim printed (#2902) (#2905) (`d6ea7cd7`)
- Tools: probe.py checks a directory of probe programs on each target with the worktree's compiler, and with --base the merge base's, in one call (#2758) (#2904) (`785735b6`)
- Tools: issue.py claim makes the issue's directory afresh with master's issue.py and prints it, and cleanup removes it (#2759) (#2903) (`02c4c3ec`)
- Tools: suite.py refuses a whole run of a slow test project outside the gate, so a script cannot get past the hook (#2788) (#2896) (`ae192f8a`)
- Tools: .claude/settings.json runs the agents' Bash under bash, so `echo ====` and an unmatched glob no longer drop a command (#2871) (#2895) (`76e0dff5`)
- SDK frontend: the author's text is read once before the stages, and the policies read the trees already read (#2714) (#2893) (`902ed715`)
- Language server: physical files bind with their namespaces, so two types of one name in two folders are two symbols (#2890) (#2892) (`b4832845`)
- Language: the merge and the library registry read each file once and write the internal names into its tree (#2876) (#2891) (`a4260a51`)
- Language: a call whose value is a constant folds to it, and a condition over it keeps one arm (#2879) (#2887) (`c77f79a3`)
- Language: the bind resolves physical namespaces, and the composer only writes the names it finds (#2713) (#2884) (`2dec5441`)
- Language: a static field takes storage and start-up code only when compiled code names it (#2878) (#2883) (`cf4ac1dc`)
- Frozen fixtures: the staircase, diagonal-scroll-v1 and runner-lift-v1 follow under Game.Run, with cadence bounds re-measured (#2828) (#2877) (`ac31c115`)
- Tools: issue.py start reads its command one way, and claim and roadmap-add read a parent roadmap one way (#2874) (#2875) (`7b46f44e`)
- Workflow: batch picks check every claimed worktree's files, and Claiming.md leaves the roadmap cap to claim (#2869) (#2873) (`4e2c704d`)
- Tools: issue.py claim refuses a roadmap's third claim (#2833) (#2872) (`9de0017c`)
- Workflow: Claiming.md names issue.py roadmap-state for reading and writing a roadmap's state comment (#2867) (#2870) (`8d58ebf9`)
- Tools: issue.py roadmap-state reads a roadmap's state comment with the newer comments, and writes it only under a size cap (#2855) (#2868) (`4e5b2136`)
- Workflow: continued review rounds end in a report file that issue.py wait returns on; long commands run through issue.py start and wait (#2866) (`f70098cf`)
- Docs: a Markdown line under docs/ stays under 200 characters, so a line-bounded read stays bounded (#2857) (#2865) (`693d32ac`)
- Tools: issue.py start runs a session's job detached, and issue.py wait returns when it ends or a file is written (#2864) (`a9aedc0a`)
- Language server: completion and signature help through the bind; SymbolResolver is retired (#2860) (`b63eb766`)
- Language: two declarations compiled under one namespaced name are an error at the later one (#2715) (#2858) (`8c3e5244`)
- Language frontend: a member a value's type does not declare is RS3106 at the member access, from the bind (#2691) (#2856) (`ce417294`)
